text: Analytics, Memberships shows how the program is growing. And when a membership on a chart isn't linked to Stripe, you can fix it by hand.
Remember: fix an unlinked membership with Link, never by starting a new subscription.
Total memberships, how many households have a member, and the split by plan.
Where signups came from: online, at the visit, or after it.
How many families who were given a sign-up card went on to join.
And signups over time, by day, week or month.
On a pet's chart, a membership that isn't connected to its Stripe subscription shows Not linked.
Find the subscription in Stripe, or in the task Scout opens for unmatched subscriptions, and copy its id.
Click Link. Scout checks it's still billing and not linked to another pet, then connects it.
Now the chart links straight to the subscription in Stripe,
and the billing card shows the card Stripe bills.
The most common mistake is starting a second subscription to fix a missing link, which bills the family twice. Remember: fix an unlinked membership with Link, never by starting a new subscription.
